new_value: {"notes":"Local half done on branch mtls-peer (worktree /data/PROJECT/mimid-worktrees/mtls-peer; commits 84095ee, b4fdbab, 841252e; not pushed). Proven with two real mimid binaries on loopback, enforce mode (crates/mimid-server/tests/mtls_binaries.rs): PKIX both directions with mimid terminating TLS (b-\u003ea updateConsent, submitMessage, groupInfo, update; a-\u003eb keyMaterial, notify), each logged mechanism=pkix with the sender's key id; refusals for no cert, wrong-domain cert, unknown CA, expired cert (403 + Accept-Signature, exact reasons logged); trusted proxy ([trusted_proxy] at 127.0.0.2, X-Client-Cert honored from the proxy only); DANE-EE and DANE-TA b-\u003ea with a stub TLSA resolver (binary's hickory resolver validates from the real root, so no local DNSSEC zone without a code change), refusing another key, insecure answer, no records. No bugs found in the mTLS code. Added an endpoint field to provider-auth log events. Test plan: docs/interop/mtls-test-plan.md.
